column3: Type what you want to send in Unicode and press backtick (`), it will be sent.
C1 for characters where case is not relevant. C for characters where case is relevant.
? for characters that are used inside words. No '?' syntax otherwise.
if we type (atom`), we get (om`). How to deal with this issue?
Remove the '?' syntax out for things that should not be a part of a word, such as symbols.
Keep the '?' syntax for letters and diacritics
